newsitem.title: UK: Unilever up as bid rumours gather pace.
newsitem.headline: Unilever up as bid rumours gather pace.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc were lifted on Wednesday by continuing speculation that the company may be poised to make a bid, dealers said.
The shares climbed 29p or 1.7 percent to 17.26 stg in active trade of over two million shares.
"The rumour of the day is that Unilever might bid for Kelloggs," said one trader.
Bid talk gathered momentum after the European Commission on Tuesday cleared the sale of Unilever's four speciality chemicals units to ICI.
Speculation was centred around how Unilever might use the $8 billion proceeds from the sale.

"There is a lot of hype around Unilever at the moment...it's more to do with how investors are behaving than what Unilever is actually doing," said Richard Newboult, industry analyst at Lehman Brothers International.
"One of the relative weaknesses in Unilever's portfolio is clearly the U.S. food industry, but Kelloggs does not strike me as Unilever's style," he added.
